en: Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor a fetter, a state that is a cause and a fetter arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [results] under the root condition … pe … three [results] under the non-disappearance condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor a tie, a state that is a cause and a tie arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a root and not a flood, a state that is a root and a flood arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
In the case of root condition, five ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, five.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor associated, a state that is a cause and associated arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Five [conditions] in the case of root; ... pe ... five in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor an hindrance, a state that is a cause and an hindrance arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Dependent on a state that is not a root and not associated with misapprehension, a state that is a root and associated with misapprehension arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
